_note: KnowledgeSourceSchema (packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-source.zod.ts) — a knowledge source, the stack's `knowledgeSources` (ADR-0161 K4). Seeded 2026-11-26 with the type itself (#37304): every key that parses is read by the knowledge service (`@objectstack/service-knowledge`), which loads the published items; the keys ADR-0161 K6 retired are tombstones, classified dead. The protection fields (`_lock*`, `_provenance`, `_packageId`) are the framework overlay fields every kind carries and are judged where every kind's are.
